user.title: TCL AC Local
user.description: Local LAN control for TCL air conditioners (BroadLink/DNA). No cloud login.

local_discovery.title: Local discovery
local_discovery.description: Discover already-paired TCL ACs on the LAN and fetch local keys via BroadLink auth. No account.

data_description.scan_subnet: Probe each address on Home Assistant's /24 when broadcast fails.

select_local.title: Select devices
select_local.description: Choose which discovered ACs to add.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Enter host, MAC and local key (32 hex) if already known.
